scope: Known-ineligible handoff early rejection: original parent/current increment and current M6 opportunity gate
architecture_limit: arm64 native; x86_64 under Rosetta, not native Intel
work: Original same-state fixture: 64x64 B4, N=K/H0 history roots and one exact old View, Preserve full write; transaction begin through mutation/seal/canonical commit; full old/new bytes/work/close/drain checks
state: Independent dual exact replicas for hit and three blockers on both arms; one replica for single. No artificial alternate generation between timed operations; each sample independently initialized
outside_timer: Setup, before creation, pixel/work verification, blocker release/completion, provider close, Store destruction and reclamation drain; retained as separate raw durations and budget observations
control: Copied coordinator TU disables discoverBefore before queryMutationBase. Same compiler/link inputs except explicit TLS control. No phase recorder during time samples; optional original recorder only in separate mechanism scope

parent_comparison.metric: actual completed-operation throughput current/parent; median 20 balanced two-pair log blocks
parent_comparison.meaning: 20-bucket family nominal 95% intervals. Improvement only when lower>1; hit/single controls reported, absence of significance is not equivalence

calibration.metric: normal-on selection image/original current product completed-operation throughput; median 20 balanced two-pair log blocks
calibration.meaning: Covers hit, single and all three blockers before product qualification. Twice the prior measured samples per process, fixed before data; no additive correction or optional extension

hit.metric: median 40 paired log(off/on process median completed-operation latency)

miss.metric: actual completed operations/sum measured operation wall intervals, on/off ratio; median 20 balanced two-pair log blocks

protected: Fresh and H4 retain original fixed-M5 public fixtures, 40 pairs/four buckets per family, 250 ms completed-rate/20 order blocks, 50000 bootstrap seed260926, one-sided98.75% lower>=0.98. Fresh new samples, original controls unchanged
preflight: 90 two-sample fixture processes plus two selection-image targeted QTest processes, after full current-source safety. All images/states, tight single-Fresh/dual-Fresh/dual-handoff and four-generation controls
mechanism: 40 processes: both architectures, K1/K16, all five cases, original parent and current images, two samples each, original diagnostic phase observer enabled. Expect current native-pin Prepared/Install=0, current generic lease/last-use all recoverable phases=0; hit/single mechanism unchanged. Timings excluded from performance claims
order: Strictly sequential processes, rotate buckets each pair, reverse comparison order every pair. Adjacent even/odd pairs are predeclared blocks for rate families. No concurrent build, test, profiler or benchmark. Save one bounded result JSON per process and consolidate once per scope, avoiding repeated whole-history rewrites outside the timer
stopping: Exactly planned pairs; no slow-sample trimming, resampling or threshold change. Stop affected scope on wrong work/bytes/image, source/runtime change, timeout or abnormal exit; retain failures and repair into separately named scope
qualification: Independent families; no pooled confidence claim. Parent/current original-library increment remains interpretable even if switch calibration is inconclusive. Same-image gate results do not grant product qualification without calibration. Metadata residency denominator, CP0 required and business/GPU/M7/M8 remain separate
